system.description:
The target gains [Cancel (Flame): 30]. It also does not receive Bad Statuses from attacks with the [Flame] tag. This effect is treated as a Combat Status. Thin red-colored, oval-shaped, lustrous pearl. It contains a powerful magic that grants fire resistance to all nearby allies when used. The effect lasts about 30 minutes, and it is highly valued for clearing areas where flames are raging. However, it requires many rare materials to craft and is a consumable item, making it expensive and difficult to purchase.

Stonified Carrot[Core Material](140G)+Fish Scale Pearl(Basic)(45G)×3+Area Protection Scroll(Basic)(10,00G)+[Magic Catalyst 8](70G)×2+Crafting Cost(185G)
